I'll start by reading the advisory and changelogs, and looking at the deploy tools.

Classification is done. Six environments need the fix, so I'm building those commits now.

loyalty-svc failed to build, so it becomes `build_failed` and I won't deploy anything there. I'm deploying the other five.

The hotfix is rolled out to every production environment except `loyalty-svc@prod`, whose build failed. That one is still unfixed, so I marked the run `partial`.

I wrote `/app/hotfix-report.json` and `/app/STATUS.json`, and both parse as valid JSON. I didn't re-run `deploy` status after the deploys. The commits listed as live come from each deploy call's response.

- **`deployed` (5):**
  - `cart-api@prod` is now on `2a2a83f`, because its live `release/4.3` commit sat below the revert.
  - `checkout-svc@prod-eu` is now on `aec3b0e`.
  - `reco-engine@prod` is now on `aec3b0e`.
  - `session-gw@prod-eu` is now on `aec3b0e`.
  - `webhooks-out@prod` is now on `2a2a83f`.
- **`already_fixed` (4):**
  - `checkout-svc@prod`
  - `profile-api@prod`
  - `session-gw@prod`
  - `webhooks-out@prod-eu`, because the reapply on `release/4.3` came after the revert.
- **`not_affected` (5):**
  - `admin-console@prod`, because it runs `release/4.0`.
  - `catalog-api@prod`
  - `geo-svc@prod`
  - `mail-relay@prod`
  - `pricing-api@prod`
- **`build_failed` (1):** `loyalty-svc@prod`. The build of `1f173c7` on `release/4.1` failed, and I deployed nothing in its place.

I didn't touch `staging`, move any environment to another branch, or roll anything back.
